_readme: OFT meshes `meshReport.ts` must NOT unify, keyed by any asset group in the
mesh, with the reason. A mesh is excluded when a peer link joins two
different assets or when its canonical group is itself a ticker collision.
Reviewed 2026-09-25 over all 88 split meshes of the omni-list; every other
one is a single asset under several keys. An exclusion added AFTER a mesh
was unified does not undo it: delete that mesh's rows from mesh-groups.json.

exclude.KRWT::KRWT: IQ's second Ethereum adapter (0xf1f3…) peers into the KRWT mesh; IQ and KRWT are different tokens
exclude.AMP: chain 1's `AMP` group is Flexa's AMP; the Amped Finance deployment filed there is itself mis-grouped, so its mesh must not be pulled into it
